title: KP Launches Partridge Hunting Season with Permits
excerpt: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa permits partridge hunting in designated game reserves starting November 15, 2026, under specific permit rules.
body_html:
The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Wildlife Department has officially opened the partridge hunting season across designated game reserves within the province.

Hunters will be allowed to participate in the season starting from November 15, 2026. However, participation is subject to a special permit requirement mandated by the wildlife authorities.

Official game reserves are the only locations where the activity is permitted during this designated period. Authorities have not yet disclosed further details regarding the exact cost or application process for obtaining the required permits.
